verdict.rationale: Xero's developer portal advertises APIs, SDKs, code samples and documentation. It also publishes official OpenAPI (Swagger) descriptions, which could be loaded into third-party tools to explore and run calls. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party interactive, try-it-in-browser API reference. Missing for 10: a documented first-party interactive API explorer, runnable in-page examples, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.
